cues: The king is Ranabahadur Shah, twenty three, grandson of Prithvi Narayan Shah: absolute, proud, and sudden in anger.
Chakari means flattering and serving the powerful, or pleading your poverty before them, to win favour; in this play everyone practises it.
And satire uses humour, irony and exaggeration to expose faults, in order to correct them.
The target here is the feudal system, in which a king and lords hold the power and common people have few rights.
